summary: Frontend testing iteration 26: Verified unified Sales/Multi-Jugada interface. All test cases PASSED. Multi-Jugada button correctly removed from dashboard menu. New Sales interface allows multi-lottery selection with checkboxes, 'Todas' button, selection badges, and play type selection with count indicator. Backend API /api/tickets/multi works correctly for creating tickets with multiple lotteries.
critical_code_review_comments: The unification of Vender and Multi-Jugada interfaces is well implemented
State management correctly handles selectedLotteries as an array
Cart creation properly generates one CartItem per selected lottery
UI provides good feedback with selection badges showing count of selected lotteries
seed_data_creation: Created test ticket via API with multi-lottery selection: TKT-20260213210834-4997
context_for_next_testing_agent: The unified Sales interface is working correctly. Multi-lottery selection, play type selection, and cart functionality all work as expected. The Multi-Jugada button has been successfully removed from the dashboard.

test_1_multi_jugada_removed_from_dashboa.description: Verified 'Multi-Jugada' button is NOT in dashboard menu - correctly removed

test_2_multi_lottery_selection_with_chec.description: Verified sales page allows selecting multiple lotteries with checkboxes. Each lottery chip shows a checkbox icon.

test_3_todas_button_functionality.description: Verified 'Todas' button selects all open lotteries (22 lotteries selected). Button toggles to 'Deseleccionar' when all selected.

test_4_selection_badge_and_step2_message.description: Verified selection badge shows 'X lotería(s) seleccionada(s)' and Step 2 shows message '(se aplicará a las X lotería(s) seleccionada(s))'

test_5_play_types_visible.description: Verified all 4 play types visible: Quiniela (1 número), Pale (2 números), Tripleta (3 números), Super Pale (2 números) with multipliers

test_6_api_multi_lottery_ticket_creation.description: Verified /api/tickets/multi creates tickets with multiple plays (one per selected lottery). Test ticket created with 2 lotteries, same numbers, same amount.

test_api_tickets_multi.description: POST /api/tickets/multi successfully creates multi-play ticket with separate entries for each lottery
